nodes.title: Start new gens by making sure 'Enable Final Pass' is\nturned offthen click Manual Random Seed button below
Disable all but the first Stage 1 Sampler Preview and it will automatically\nproceed to finalization. Makes the WF function like a normal 1-pass workflow.\nMake sure "Upscale Pass" is turned off!
These above options will make the workflow function as i2v or FFLF,\nforcing the model to consider <Picture 1> the first frame, and/or <Picture 2> as the last frame.
After the First Pass Sample Previews finishes, select which of\nthe 3 looks best below. Then continue right ->

Start your upscale by clicking the below button. If you don't like the result, you can reroll\nby clicking the button as many times as you like to get variations of the first pass! (Unless\nyou change something like prompt, resolution, refs, ANYTHING that happened before this step)
CUSTOM NODE LINKS

.: V2V Editing (replace a character in a target video) --- NOTE: TENDS TO LOOK BETTER ON SINGLE PASS. SEE OPTION ABOVE ---

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the girl whose motion comes from <Video 1> and whose appearance comes from <Picture 1>.
<Video 1> is the source video for the target video edit.

summary:
[video editing + reference generation] The target video is an edited version of <Video 1>. The girl's appearance is styled from <Picture 1>. Her motion, camera movement, background, and lighting from the video are preserved continuously from start to finish without deviation at any point.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears throughout [Shot 1]): partially_preserved - the girl's face, body proportions, and skin tone from <Picture 1> are retained, and her motion, choreography, rhythm, and timing from <Video 1> are retained at every moment. 
<Video 1> (whole-video temporal structure, motion path, camera movement, background, lighting): fully_preserved - the girl's choreography, movement speed, gestures, body positions, camera framing, camera movement, background, and lighting from every frame of <Video 1> are preserved throughout the entire target video without deviation.

detailed_description:
The target video uses a naturalistic style matching the source footage, preserving its original lighting, color grading, and camera work.
[Shot 1] The camera follows <Subject 1>, the girl, as she exists in the same setting from <Video 1>. Her appearance matches <Picture 1> — same skin tone, body shape, and natural contours. Throughout the entire video, her motion is a frame-by-frame motion match to <Video 1>: the same choreography, gestures, limb positions, movement speed, and rhythm are followed continuously from start to finish. The camera framing, angle, and movement stay locked to <Video 1> at all times. The background remains identical and unchanged.


.: Reference Generation (general filmmaking):

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the character in <Picture 1>. (basic description)

<Subject 2> is the scene location in <Picture 2>. (basic scene description)

summary:
[reference generation + audio reference] highly realistic live-action scene of <Subject 1> in <Subject 2>.

retention_analysis:
<Audio 1>: reference - the target speaker follows <Audio 1>'s voice timbre and measured delivery without copying the original signal.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1]: a close up shot of <Subject 1> with a shocked expression as the camera pulls in towards her face. Suddenly, she turns around to look behind her.
[Shot 2]: a 3/4ths shot of <Subject 1> as she turns, her expression is confused. She tilts her head to one side, a look of questioning. She hesitantly says using <Audio 1> as her vocal-timbre reference: <d>[English]Hello?.. Is anyone there?</d> her tone is hesitant and suspicious.
[Shot 3]: an over-the-shoulder following shot as <Subject 1> begins to walk through <Subject 2> looking around side to side.
 
overall_soundscape:
interior ambience

non_diegetic_music:
N/A

nodes.title: Just want basic i2v or FFLF? Use these options
When you've selected which Sample Preview to upscale, enable the below toggle\nthen continue right ->

widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the chibi moth-girl character from <Picture 1>. Preserve her exact identity and proportions: very short childlike chibi body, pale skin, short pastel pink-lavender hair, large pink-magenta eyes, and oversized fluffy moth-themed hood. Preserve the dark muted-purple fluffy hood and cape, white fluffy face trim, black-and-pink eye-like hood markings, two long feather-like antennae with blue-purple-pink gradients, pastel moth wings, and one large fluffy purple tail. Preserve her pink onesie with the dark-purple upper section and soft solid-color transitions, white cuffs, tiny dark boots, skull-shaped neck ornament, and the same polished soft 3D-rendered character style. She has exactly one tail and one pair of moth wings. Do not add or remove costume elements, limbs, wings, antennae, or tails.

summary:
[reference generation] A fast-paced 10-second comedic fantasy sequence follows <Subject 1> attempting to dramatically burn a distant tree with a tiny fireball. Her spell unexpectedly acts as growth magic: the tree rapidly becomes larger, produces fruit, and attracts cheerful woodland animals. She reacts with immediate disgust and disappointment.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears throughout all shots): fully_preserved - preserve the character's exact facial design, small chibi proportions, hair, moth hood, antennae, wings, single fluffy tail, onesie, colors, materials, and polished 3D appearance throughout every action and camera angle. Never enlarge her relative to the environment.

detailed_description:
The target video uses a polished stylized 3D animated-film look matching <Subject 1>, with soft dimensional materials, warm daylight, expressive exaggerated animation, and fast comedic timing. The setting is a spacious woodland clearing with one ordinary mature tree. Maintain believable environmental scale throughout: <Subject 1> is a tiny chibi girl and the tree is much taller and larger than her.

[Shot 1] A wide establishing shot clearly shows the spatial distance between <Subject 1> and the tree. <Subject 1> stands on the far left side of the clearing while the mature tree stands on the far right, roughly 8–10 meters away, with a broad stretch of empty grass visibly separating them. Her entire small body is visible from head to feet, and the entire tree from roots to canopy is also visible in the same frame. The tree towers several times higher than her; she must never appear giant-sized or comparable in height to the tree. Keep the camera pulled back rather than framing her close to the trunk.

<Subject 1> dramatically plants her feet, lowers her body, spreads her moth wings slightly, and raises both hands like a powerful fantasy mage. Her fluffy cape and single large tail sway behind her. A comically tiny orange-red fireball sputters into existence between her hands. She forcefully thrusts both arms forward and launches it. The camera remains wide as the tiny glowing fireball visibly flies across the long stretch of open grass from left to right for a moment before reaching the distant tree, making the distance and scale unmistakable.

[Shot 2] At 00:02.500, the fireball finally reaches the distant tree and hits its trunk with a weak magical pop. Instead of catching fire, glowing green-gold energy instantly races through the tree. The trunk rapidly thickens, branches shoot upward and outward, and a huge leafy canopy bursts into existence. The camera tilts upward at fast speed with the growth as colorful ripe fruit rapidly sprouts across the branches.

[Shot 3] At 00:05.500, the camera cuts to a medium-wide shot with <Subject 1> small in the foreground and the now enormous fruit tree dominating the background. Apples and pears drop gently onto the grass as cheerful woodland animals enter from visible background paths: rabbits hop toward the fruit, squirrels rush up the trunk, and small birds flutter onto the branches. <Subject 1> freezes completely, staring at the unexpectedly wholesome result.

[Shot 4] At 00:07.500, the camera pushes into a medium close-up of <Subject 1> while enough of the enormous fruit tree and happy animals remain visible behind her to preserve their scale. Her stunned expression rapidly becomes exaggerated disgust: eyelids lower, brows tighten, and her body recoils. She looks at a tiny residual flame flickering on one fingertip, then back at the flourishing tree, visibly offended by her own magic. She pinches the flame out, crosses her arms, turns her head away with an irritated huff, and gives the animals one final disgusted side-eye. Her single fluffy tail flicks sharply as a rabbit cheerfully munches fruit nearby.

overall_soundscape:
Soft woodland ambience under rapid magical action. The tiny fireball makes a weak whoosh as it travels across the clearing and a soft pop when it finally reaches the tree, followed by fast creaking wood, bursting leaves, magical sparkles, dropping fruit, fluttering wings, cheerful animal sounds, and <Subject 1>'s irritated final huff.

non_diegetic_music:
Exaggerated fantasy percussion accompanies her dramatic spell preparation before abruptly switching to fast playful pizzicato strings when the tiny fireball appears. Bright woodwinds accompany the accidental growth, ending with a short comedic sting on her disgusted reaction.
